llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要讨论翻修全髋关节置换术中模块化股骨柄的外科技术，未涉及生物力学建模或应力遮挡分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on surgical technique and clinical outcomes of modular femoral stems in revision THA, without any biomechanical modeling, stress shielding quantification, micromotion analysis, or finite element validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 介绍模块化股骨柄在翻修全髋关节置换术中的应用技术。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性描述模块化股骨柄的适应症、手术步骤和临床经验。
summary_zh.result: 模块化股骨柄可提供更好的稳定性和骨量保留。
summary_zh.validation: 基于临床病例系列的经验总结。

summary_en.motivation: To describe the surgical techniques and clinical applications of modular femoral stems in revision total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A review of modular stem design rationale, surgical indications, step-by-step implantation technique, and reported clinical outcomes.
summary_en.result: Modular femoral stems offer versatility in restoring hip biomechanics and preserving bone stock during revision surgery.
summary_en.validation: The paper summarizes clinical experience from case series, without quantitative biomechanical or finite element validation.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文讨论了全髋关节置换术中减少失血的临床方法，与股骨假体应力遮挡或微动分析无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on clinical blood loss reduction and does not quantify stress shielding, micromotion, or any biomechanical modeling of the hip implant.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究含抑肽酶的纤维蛋白密封剂能否减少全髋置换术失血
summary_zh.method: 随机对照临床试验，比较密封剂组与对照组失血量

summary_en.motivation: To determine whether an aprotinin-containing fibrin sealant reduces blood loss in total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A randomized controlled trial comparing blood loss between patients receiving the sealant and controls.
summary_en.result: The fibrin sealant did not significantly reduce blood loss.
summary_en.validation: Clinical randomized controlled trial with standard outcome measures.

summary_en.motivation: To review clinical factors influencing total hip arthroplasty outcomes in obese patients.
summary_en.method: A literature review synthesizing evidence on surgical complications, implant selection, and perioperative management.
summary_en.result: Obesity increases risks of infection, dislocation, and aseptic loosening, but outcomes remain acceptable with proper technique.
summary_en.validation: No original biomechanical validation; conclusions are drawn from clinical studies.

papers.title: An Anesthesia, Surgery, and Harvest Method for the Evaluation of Transpedicular Screws Using an In Vivo Porcine Lumbar Spine Model.
papers.abstract: Pedicle screw fixation is the gold standard for the treatment of spinal diseases. However, many studies have reported the issue of loosening pedicle screws after spinal surgery, which is a serious concern. To address this problem, diverse types of pedicle screws have been examined to identify those with good fixation strength and osseointegration in spine bone. The porcine spine is a good alternative for the human spine in the evaluation of pedicle screws due to the anatomical size, mechanical characteristics, and cost. Although several studies have reported that pedicle screws are efficient in the porcine model, no study has described detailed protocols for the evaluation of a pedicle screw using the porcine model. Here, we describe a detailed method for evaluating transpedicular screws using an in vivo porcine lumbar spine model. The technical details for anesthesia, spine surgery, and harvest provided here will facilitate with the evaluation of the transpedicular screw fixation model.

summary_zh.method: 描述了麻醉、手术及组织采集的具体步骤。

summary_zh.validation: 体内猪模型验证手术可行性。

summary_en.motivation: To establish a standardized surgical protocol for evaluating transpedicular screws in a porcine lumbar spine model.
summary_en.method: Detailed procedures for anesthesia, spine surgery, and post-operative tissue harvest were described.
summary_en.result: The protocol enables reproducible assessment of pedicle screw fixation and osseointegration in vivo.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through an in vivo porcine model demonstrating the feasibility of the surgical approach.
